_comment: Baselines for bench/group-link-matching/measure.mjs --check (#1188). `fingerprint` is a sha256 over every cross-link (matchType, both endpoints, contractId) and every unmatched contract the matching stage produces for the 8000-link corpus. It is a CORRECTNESS gate: it moves when a link consumer matches a repo its link does not name, or when a consumer the passes could not place drops out of `unmatched`. Drift must be explained, never re-baselined to make CI green. Controls measured when this was added: the matcher from before #1188 gives e88a510a… (55,232 cross-links instead of 31,216, the spread); `repo::contractId` bookkeeping gives f2f7e0c5… (800 consumers missing from unmatched); removing the strip leaves the fingerprint unchanged and fails the separate `leakedProviderRepo` count (9,616 instead of 0).
_scaling_note: (t_large/t_small)/(8000/2000). About 1.0 is linear in the number of links. OBSERVED BAND: 1.04-1.19 over nine runs on a 24-core dev box at load average 5. A six-point sweep from 1,000 to 32,000 links (6,632 to 211,232 contracts) gave 10.6, 23.9, 53.2, 116, 256 and 537 ms, a log-log slope of 1.13; the part above 1.0 is the provider index outgrowing the cache, and the pre-#1188 matcher measures 1.15 on the same corpus. Floor check: one extra walk of the provider index per consumer in the exact pass measures 2.0-2.3 with an unchanged fingerprint. TRIAGE: a scaling failure is a timing signal, so re-run it on an idle machine before investigating; the fingerprint is deterministic and a re-run never changes it. NOT GATED, measured on purpose: the wildcard pass walks the whole provider index once per service-wildcard consumer, and the exact pass does the same for a method-agnostic http link (`/path` without `METHOD::`) and for a bare-name thrift method. Those costs are (such links x provider keys) and predate #1188: with the wildcard links growing with the corpus the ratio is 2.1-2.3 at 1000/4000 links, with every link method-agnostic it is 3.3-3.5 (2.0 s at 4,000 links), the same before and after #1188. The corpus therefore holds a fixed 16 wildcard links and only explicit-method http links.
_absolute_ms_note: Matching stage for 8,000 links (52,832 contracts). Measured 112-131 ms; the ceiling leaves about 4.5x for shared CI runners.
